chunks: "The first thing our Qa'im will begin with is the roofs of the mosques: he will break them and order that they be made into a canopy like the canopy of Musa."

key_terms.عَرِيشًا: a canopy or simple overhead covering
key_terms.قَائِمُنَا: our Qa'im, the one who will rise from the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.كَعَرِيشِ مُوسَى: like the canopy of Musa عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What will the Qa'im do first with the roofs of the mosques according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes an action of the Qa'im in relation to the mosques at the time of his rise. It presents a restoration of simplicity in sacred spaces, likening them to the canopy of Musa عليه السلام.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.706 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:

"The first thing our Qa'im (the awaited savior Imam Muhammad ibn Hassan Al-Mahdi (as) ) will do is to break the roofs of the mosques and order them to be made as an open canopy (like the canopy of Musa (as))”.
